text: Example 1: Basic. If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded? Compare the words letter by letter. C, position 3, becomes D, position 4. That is +1. A, position 1, becomes B, position 2. That is +1. T, position 20, becomes U, position 21. That is +1. The rule holds for every letter: move each letter one step forward. Apply it to DOG. D becomes E, O becomes P, G becomes H. DOG is coded as EPH. Notice that we checked the rule on all three letters before using it. That habit will save you from traps later.
